p4_b0.ocr: In examining the inflows and outflows across various fund types, this report highlights critical trends within GIC Private Limited’s multi-asset portfolio. Furthermore, a detailed review of the AlternativeAssets category highlights an allocation of 5.1% and an associated amount of CHF500M.
